shortDescription: According to Wallstreetcn, California lawmakers have filed a bill to update the state's wildfire response mechanism without shifting compensation liability away from listed utility companies, while aiming to strengthen post-wildfire recovery, speed payments to survivors, and impose new restrictions…

children: According to Wallstreetcn, California lawmakers have filed a bill to update the state's wildfire response mechanism without shifting compensation liability away from listed utility companies, while aiming to strengthen post-wildfire recovery, speed payments to survivors, and impose new restrictions on hedge funds that file wildfire-related lawsuits against utilities.

title: California Lawmakers File Bill to Update Wildfire Response Without Shifting Liability From Utilities
